name: Bottomless Pockets
body:
Your pockets seem to have no end of useful objects that you packed with you on your journey.

Prerequisite(s): Deeper Pockets, 8th-level chronicler

Benefit: You can carry up to 200 gp of unspecified equipment per class level using your deep pockets ability instead of the amount you could previously carry. Additionally, retrieving an item you specify at the time takes only a move action. You can also choose to pack your gear in only 30 minutes and still receive the +4 bonus to your Strength to determine your light encumbrance, or you can choose to take a full hour and receive a +8 bonus. Finally, your bonus to Sleight of Hand checks made to conceal small objects on your person increases from +4 to +8.

Normal: See the deep pockets ability and the Deeper Pockets feat.
